3 to 6 gms twice daily with milk.

sections.side_effects:
There are no known side effects with this medicine. 
 This medicine should be taken only under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine is discouraged. 
 Very high dosage may cause diarrhea and indigestion. 
 People with diabetes, high cholesterol, heart diseases and high BP should take this medicine under special care. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Dhatryadi Ghrita 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam, Ghrita prakarana 
 Dhatryadi Ghrita is an Ayurvedic medicine, in herbal ghee form. This medicine has ghee as its base. Dhatri refers to Amalaki (Indian gooseberry), which is the main ingredient of this herbal ghee. It balances the pitta dosha in body. Use of this ayurvedic medicine is done in female problems like leucorrhoea, menorrhagia, metrorrhagia and anemia etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Dhatri (Amla) – Emblica officinalis – juice – 768 ml 
 Vidari rasa – Pueraria tuberosa – juice – 768 ml 
 Ikshu rasa – Sugarcane juice – 768 ml 
 Shatavari rasa – Asparagus racemosus – 768 ml 
 Kushmanda rasa – Benincasa hispida – 768 ml 
 Ghee – 768 ml 
 Milk – 768 ml 
 
 24 g of each of:- 
 
 Dried small grapes – raisins 
 Mulethi – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Sandal wood – Santalum album 
 Sugar 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 The above combination is heated till herbal ghee is prepared. 
 Indications 
 
 Leucorrhoea 
 Menorrhagia 
 Metrorrhagia 
 Anemia 
 Female infertility 
 Schizophrenia 
 Alcoholism 
 
 Dosage 
 3 to 6 gms twice daily with milk. 
 
 As medicine – quarter to half teaspoon with water, usually before food, once or twice a day, or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is usually administered with warm water and a little sugar. 
 
 Side Effects 
 
 There are no known side effects with this medicine. 
 This medicine should be taken only under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine is discouraged. 
 Very high dosage may cause diarrhea and indigestion. 
 People with diabetes, high cholesterol, heart diseases and high BP should take this medicine under special care. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
